verdict.line: You lose if you let the enemy jungler collapse on a greedy Test of Spirit; you win almost every even skirmish or extended trade.

brief.thesis: Illaoi wins this matchup 60.4% over 48 games because Ornn has no reliable way to stop E (Test of Spirit) from ripping his spirit out, and every point of magic damage he deals back gets echoed onto himself. Ornn's only real counterplay is positioning around W (Bellows Breath) range and waiting for his jungler, since he cannot out-trade a fair E/Q exchange.

theirWindow.when: W (Bellows Breath) off cooldown, you're overextended
theirWindow.what: Ornn's W applies Brittle on the final flame, which sets up his E (Searing Charge) knockup if he can reach terrain. Don't stand in his W cone-length space near a wall if his jungler is missing.

yourWindow.when: Ornn's W and E are both down
yourWindow.what: Walk up and land E (Test of Spirit) on him immediately. With no Brittle setup and no charge available, he has nothing but Q (Volcanic Rupture) to punish you, and your tentacles plus the spirit echo win the trade outright.

start.why: Taken in 81.4% of games (58.3% win rate) — the extra AD and sustain let you win E trades without burning Health Potions early.

boots.why: Picked in 53.6% of games at a 63.3% win rate — the tenacity blunts his Q slow and any follow-up Brittle-knockup chains from allies.

core.why: Core first item in both top build paths — the armor shred stacks hard against Ornn's passive bonus Armor/MR, undoing his tankiness.
Taken in the 77.8%-win-rate path — the slow proc punishes him for standing in E (Test of Spirit) or trying to walk away.
Caps every core path listed — the shield and AD scaling keep you alive through his R elemental collisions and E knockup attempts.

situational.when: ornn builds into his own magic damage items and you need the healing amp back
he's grouping with a jungler who adds burst damage you need to delay
you want extra burst on isolated E/W all-ins before his R comes online

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the higher-pick-rate page (36.1% pick) — the sustain damage rewards the extended trades E (Test of Spirit) forces, which is exactly how you beat Ornn.

summoners.why: Run in 70.5% of games at a 60.5% win rate — Teleport lets you reset after winning the early trades and keep pace with Ornn's forged-item gold advantage.

playing.title: Open every trade with E
playing.detail: Test of Spirit (E, cooldown 16/15/14/13/12s) rips his spirit out and echoes damage back onto him. Land it before he can walk into minion range to break line of sight.

playing.title: Track his W cooldown, not just mana
playing.detail: Bellows Breath (W, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cooldown) is his only way to apply Brittle without landing E. If it's down, he has no setup for his R knockup follow-up.

playing.title: Punish any E (Searing Charge) whiff
playing.detail: Searing Charge only knocks up if he collides with terrain — if he charges into open space he's wasted a 14-12s cooldown with no payoff. Walk him down immediately after.

playing.title: Hold E for isolated skirmishes
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read confirms you can win skirmishes with his jungler present if you sequence E into W (Harsh Lesson) correctly — don't save cooldowns defensively.

playing.title: Respect his R past level 6
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God (R, cooldown 140/120/100/100/100s) can be recast to redirect the elemental into a second knockup. Don't fight near his flank once the elemental is summoned.

playing.title: Watch jungler pathing specifically
playing.detail: Ornn's kit is built for setting up ganks via Brittle and knockups, not winning 1v1s. The only way you lose this lane per OP.GG's own tip is getting caught by a jungler while overextended.

playing.title: Itemize through his armor stacking
playing.detail: His passive grants bonus Armor/MR from all sources, so Black Cleaver's shred into Iceborn Gauntlet is what keeps your physical damage relevant into the late game.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 60.4% win-rate figure over 48 games are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch; the ability timings, trade sequencing, and skirmish reasoning are this brief's own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Illaoi has the upper hand in almost all instances against Ornn. However, Ornn is good at setting up ganks so always be wary of where the enemy jungler is at. You can even win skirmishes with enemy jungler if you use your abilities accordingly.
